newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open mostly unchanged Monday as prices are seen consolidating gains made during the previous session, dealers said.
Thursday, benchmark October settled 0.13 cent firmer at 11.18 cents a lb after trading from 11.22 to 10.90 cents. The rest rose 0.07 to 0.10.
CSCE was closed Friday for U.S. Independence Day.

Traders said the strong technical close on Thursday could inspire additional buying during today's session, and pegged resistance in October at Thursday's high of 11.22 cents followed by the life-of-contract high of 11.40 cents.
In fundamental news, Indonesia said it will allow sugar producers to import raw sugar. Previously, the state commodities regulator BULOG held a monopoly.

In London, white sugar futures firmed on Monday with traders focused on the August/October switch ahead of August's expiry. At 0841 EDT/1241 GMT, LIFFE August stood $1.10 higher at $320.30. October was also trading $1.10 higher, while the rest of the board was up $1.10 to $0.60.
